The '''Belasco sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in this sector included [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]], [[Khemerion]], [[Tintel]], [[Urun Five]] and [[Zirulast]].
